note: Realistic filled-in states in the scoring engine's shape. `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`. `hasCriticalFinding` covers only a mass lesion or a perforation complication — a large polyp (>= 20mm) grades major severity via a separate rule but is deliberately not in that predicate, so it would still only reach 'urgent' follow-up, not 'critical-alert' (not exercised directly below, but the same pattern as bronchoscopy's extrinsic compression and blood-cross-match's insufficient-units).

personas.name: normal-screening-colonoscopy-to-caecum-complete
personas.description: A normal diagnostic colonoscopy to the caecum with good bowel preparation: no polyps, mass, diverticulosis, inflammation, angiodysplasia, or bleeding source, every mandatory report section present — expect normal classification + none severity + 100% completeness + routine follow-up + no-action.

state.clinicalHistory: Change in bowel habit for 6 weeks, normal FIT test — diagnostic colonoscopy to exclude colorectal pathology.
state.findingsNarrative: Caecum reached; mucosa normal throughout with no polyps, mass, diverticulosis, inflammation, or angiodysplasia.
state.impression: Normal colonoscopy to the caecum; no colorectal pathology identified.
state.recommendedFollowUp: No further endoscopic follow-up required for this indication.

expected.recommendedAction: No specific endoscopic follow-up required; manage per usual care.

firedRules.description: No abnormal structured findings on an interpretable examination; classified as normal.
No abnormal finding; abnormality severity graded none.
No escalation rule fired; routine follow-up only.

personas.name: abnormal-multiple-polyps-high-risk-surveillance-moderate-complete
personas.description: A positive-FIT screening colonoscopy finds and removes four adenomatous polyps, the largest 12mm: the polyp count (>= 3) and size (>= 10mm) together place this in the high-risk surveillance band, grading moderate severity; report complete — expect abnormal classification + moderate severity (high-risk-surveillance) + 100% completeness + recommended follow-up + further-imaging.

state.clinicalHistory: Positive FIT test, National Bowel Cancer Screening Programme referral.
state.findingsNarrative: Four adenomatous polyps identified throughout the colon, the largest 12mm in the sigmoid colon; all removed by snare polypectomy.
state.impression: Four adenomatous polyps removed; high-risk surveillance group per BSG / ACPGBI / PHE guidance.
state.recommendedFollowUp: Surveillance colonoscopy at 3 years per high-risk surveillance guidance.

expected.recommendedAction: Recommend a surveillance interval or specialist referral per BSG / ACPGBI / PHE polyp-surveillance guidance.

firedRules.description: One or more abnormal structured findings are present; classified as abnormal.
An actionable abnormal finding (polyps, IBD inflammation, angiodysplasia, or an identified bleeding source) is present; severity graded moderate.

personas.name: critical-suspected-malignant-mass-uncommunicated-incomplete
personas.description: A large, irregular, friable mass seen at the hepatic flexure, highly suspicious for malignancy and partially obstructing the lumen: the mass lesion auto-escalates classification to critical and follow-up to critical-alert, with the recommended action naming an urgent MDT / colorectal-surgical referral; the result has not yet been recorded as communicated and no originating request is linked, and the clinical history, impression, and recommended follow-up sections are not yet completed while staging is arranged — expect critical classification + major severity + 40% completeness + critical-alert follow-up + urgent-review.

state.findingsNarrative: A large, irregular, friable mass is seen at the hepatic flexure, highly suspicious for malignancy; partially obstructing the lumen.
state.clinicianNotes: Phoned through to the referring team; urgent colorectal MDT referral and staging CT being arranged.

expected.recommendedAction: Communicate the critical result directly to the referrer now, document the conversation, and arrange an urgent MDT / colorectal-surgical referral.

firedRules.description: A critical structured finding (mass lesion or perforation complication) is present; classified as critical.
Critical finding present; abnormality severity graded major.
Mandatory report section missing: clinical history.
Mandatory report section missing: recommended follow-up.
Critical finding auto-escalates follow-up urgency to critical-alert regardless of the other axes.

flags.description: A critical finding (mass lesion or perforation) is present.
flags.suggestedAction: Communicate the critical result to the referrer immediately, document the communication, and arrange an urgent MDT / colorectal-surgical referral.

flags.description: Critical finding present but the result has not been recorded as communicated.
flags.suggestedAction: Contact the referrer now and record who was informed, with date and time.

flags.description: No impression / conclusion has been recorded.
flags.suggestedAction: Add an impression that answers the clinical question.

flags.description: A significant finding is present but no originating request reference is recorded.
flags.suggestedAction: Link the report to the originating request to support discrepancy review.
